author: Vey
what_it_is: Saved of very beginning of game (starting point) with: All available characters, Max Status for all characters (level, HP, MP, strength, vitality, etc), All limit breaks, Ultimate Weapon, All Materia, Items, Weapons, Armor, Accessories, Max money (Gil)
format: DexDrive .gme: '123-456-STD' 3904-byte header (per-block comments) + 131072-byte raw card; the card holds 1 save(s), 1 for this game (BASCUS-94163FF7-S01)

verified.converted_with: tools/gamefaqs/psx-card.py card.mcr final-fantasy-vii.50.gme: unwraps the card (DexDrive .gme: 3904-byte header + card)
